He presses Go live with his typed name as his signature (01-inventory C-185). The server calls K-09 v1 saveSetupStep alone for Sam with the terms' time and the bill card's two Stripe ids from Rosie's own record (K-33 v1 bill_cards, written from Stripe's webhook), never from the page; nothing is left unsigned, so the branch is '1 Nothing left to sign' (K-09 v1 setup-s1-29-terms.json, whose answer this is). S1-32's checks then come back by themselves and S1-35 goes live (screen 22; K-09 v1 go-live-check.json, setup-s1-35-live.json), which the page reads with readRegistration.
